body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> HP unveiled its two new entertainment notebook PCs 'Pavilion dv2' and 'dv3' at 2009 CES, which redefine the concept of thin and light while still delivering full notebook capabilities.

With its innovative design, the HP Pavilion dv2 is a highly mobile notebook that's made to travel and priced within the reach of consumers. Measuring less than 1-inch thick and weighing less than 4 pounds, the dv2 provides a full notebook experience with powerful discrete graphics, high-capacity hard drive up to 500GB, and Blu-ray disc support.
